description: Figure 3 is a set of six pie charts representing problem distribution based on correctness under different settings. The six charts are divided into two groups of three, with the top group labeled "CoT" and the bottom group labeled "Verify-All", and each group further divided into "easy", "medium", and "hard" categories. Each pie chart has four slices, labeled as "N+K+", "N-K+", "N-K-", and "N+K-", with corresponding colors, although the exact colors are not specified. The proportions of each slice are shown as percentages. For the "CoT" group, the "easy" chart has slices of approximately 10.1% (N+K+), 45.9% (N-K+), 3.3% (N-K-), and 40.6% (N+K-); the "medium" chart has slices of approximately 7.2% (N+K+), 44.3% (N-K+), 3.9% (N-K-), and 44.6% (N+K-); and the "hard" chart has slices of approximately 7.0% (N+K+), 36.8% (N-K+), 20.1% (N-K-), and 36.2% (N+K-). The charts include percentage labels inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The order of the slices is consistent across the charts.
